question: Which of these sentences best describe the ongoing action(s) in the video 1?

Using left hand picking up the spatula from the sink and washing it in running water inside the sink.
With my left hand, pick up the spatula from the chopping board, hesitating first putting it down, then pick it up again.
Pick up the spatula using the right hand to flip the bacon.
correct_answer: Hold the pot steady with my left hand and, with my right hand, pick up the spatula.
